Remote (United States)
Full-time
View all jobs

Location: US – 100% Remote

Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic Junior Software Engineer to join our growing engineering team.

Responsibilities

Write, test, and maintain clean, well-documented code under the guidance of senior engineers.

Collaborate with the team to build and improve features across our platform.

Participate in code reviews, team standups, and sprint planning.

Help debug, troubleshoot, and resolve issues in existing applications.

Continuously learn new technologies, tools, and engineering best practices.

Requirements

0–2 years of professional software development experience, including internships, bootcamps, or significant personal projects.

Foundational knowledge of at least one modern programming language such as Python, JavaScript, Go, or Java.

Understanding of core data structures, algorithms, and version control with Git.

Strong willingness to learn, take feedback, and grow as an engineer.

Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote team.

Benefits

401(k)

Employee assistance program

Health insurance
